summary.intent: Run an automated QA agent (hackaton project) against test apps (kutt, Conduit), then add a findings-report module that groups and summarizes discovered bugs in the run summary.
summary.outcome: Kutt analysis passed (359 scenarios, 11 journeys). Conduit P1 run finished (114 scenarios: 80 passed, 33 failed, 1 skipped) with real bugs found. A new src/main/agent/report.ts was written, wired into the run summary, passed typecheck/lint, and was tested on real data. A 3-scenario verification run was started and its log was being inspected.

repo: Agent run logic lives in src/main/agent (run.ts has the sweep loop and run summary; report.ts is new for findings grouping/FINDINGS.md).
The project store holds run data, which can be used to test the report module against real results.
Typecheck and lint are used as the quick verification gate before real-data testing.

code.finding: New module that groups Finding objects and generates a findings report (FINDINGS.md), wired into the run summary in run.ts.

workflow: Long runs were polled with repeated ~10 minute wait commands instead of blocking.
Findings from the agent were verified against the Conduit source code instead of being trusted outright.
A suspiciously fast result (3 scenarios in 30s) prompted a check of logs and output instead of accepting the summary.
